once:
# Rename bursts like Office autosave or Git checkouts - the main
# confounder for rename-chain signatures. Must NOT delete anything.
$files = Get-ChildItem -Path "{dir}" -File | Select-Object -First 40
foreach ($f in $files) {
  $tmp = Join-Path $f.DirectoryName ("~$" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0,8) + ".tmp")
  Rename-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName -NewName (Split-Path $tmp -Leaf)
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20
  Rename-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -NewName $f.Name
}
